name: 12978-decodeheavy-8bblockfp8-1gpu
model: ${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8-BLOCK-native-qkvbf16 -- a local rewrite of mgoin/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8-BLOCK into vLLM's native block-FP8 layout, with q/k/v carried in bf16 because this engine era cannot load block scales into a fused QKV projection; recipe below.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine process, one node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=128, bounded at 512 requests / 2400 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 1000 tokens and output exactly 2000 (min = max on both), greedy.
purpose: A long-form content generator writing 2000-token drafts from 1000-token briefs for 128 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Every value below is either this engine's own resolved default, written down so it cannot
# drift, or the checkpoint. Nothing is tuned and there is no tuned.yaml.

# LOCAL PATH: no hub repo carries this checkpoint in vLLM's native block-FP8 layout, which is the
# only layout this engine's FP8 path loads block scales from. Conversion recipe in setupcard.md.
# The `-qkvbf16` suffix is a loader-compatibility variant, not a tuning choice: this engine era
# cannot load block scales into a fused QKV projection at all, so q/k/v are dequantized to bf16
# and named in the checkpoint's `ignored_layers`. Every other projection -- o_proj, gate_proj,
# up_proj, down_proj -- stays block-FP8, exactly as in the unconverted checkpoint.
model: ${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8-BLOCK-native-qkvbf16

tensor-parallel-size: 1

dtype: bfloat16

max-num-seqs: 256

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

enable-prefix-caching: false

# The one resolved default that is not the obvious value: `max-model-len` is unset so the
# checkpoint's 131072 applies, and this engine auto-enables chunked prefill above 32768
# (arg_utils.py:1167-1194). Written down for the same reason as the four above.
enable-chunked-prefill: true
